pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Accordion pattern: native heading elements containing native buttons that control panels.

roles.role: region when there are six items or fewer; otherwise none

aria.value: "true" when the panel is shown, otherwise "false"
"true" for disabled items, and for the open item in single non-collapsible mode

keyboard.action: Moves through header buttons and focusable panel content in document order.
Expands or collapses the panel (native button activation).
Moves focus to the next or previous header, wrapping (APG optional).
Moves focus to the first or last header (APG optional).

focus: Header buttons show a :focus-visible inset outline. Disabled and locked headers stay focusable so their state is discoverable. Re-rendering keeps focus on the same header.
notes: Panels use role=region only for six items or fewer, following APG guidance against landmark proliferation.
Arrow keys are handled only on header buttons, never inside panel content.
The height transition and icon rotation animation are removed under prefers-reduced-motion and animation 'none'.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
